title: Red apple with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='appleGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e02020'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b01010'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cheekGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9090'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5a5a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='8' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#6b3a1a'/>
  <rect x='48' y='8' width='2' height='16' rx='1' fill='#8a5028'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M54 12 Q70 6 74 18 Q64 24 54 20 Z' fill='#3cb043'/>
  <path d='M56 14 Q66 11 70 18 Q62 21 56 18 Z' fill='#5cd65c'/>

  <!-- apple body -->
  <path d='M50 22
    C30 22, 14 38, 14 58
    C14 78, 30 92, 50 92
    C70 92, 86 78, 86 58
    C86 38, 70 22, 50 22 Z'
    fill='url(#appleGrad)'/>

  <!-- top dimple shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='16' ry='6' fill='#c01818' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- left shine -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='45' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#ff8080' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-15 33 45)'/>

  <!-- eye whites -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='55' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='4.5' fill='#2a0a3a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='4.5' fill='#2a0a3a'/>

  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='53' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='53' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='68' rx='8' ry='5' fill='url(#cheekGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='68' rx='8' ry='5' fill='url(#cheekGrad)'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 68 Q50 80 62 68' stroke='#2a0a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tongue-ish little highlight inside smile -->
  <path d='M44 71 Q50 76 56 71' stroke='#ff7070' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
